fields.description: Global defaults for the workflow actors that cannot be derived from the Employee reporting chain. A GMP Document cannot be submitted for approval until these resolve for its department.
fields.label: Workflow Actors (Global Defaults)

fields.description: Optional. When set, publishing a GMP Document stamps this user as the CEO authority on the record — name, date and signature — for the printed signature block. Leave empty if your documents carry no CEO authorization.
fields.label: CEO

fields.description: Optional per-department overrides. An empty cell falls back to the global default above.
fields.label: Per-Department Overrides

fields.description: The font every generated document and PDF is rendered in, regardless of what the source template specifies. Install the font on the server first (it must be visible to LibreOffice in the backend AND worker containers) — this setting only tells the module which family to enforce.
fields.label: Document Font

fields.description: Rewrite the font of every generated document to the family below. Untick to honour whatever each template specifies.
fields.label: Enforce Document Font

fields.description: Must match the installed font family EXACTLY as the server reports it — check with fc-list : family | grep -i vazir in the container. Recent releases of Vazir are named Vazirmatn. A name the server cannot resolve silently falls back to a substitute font.
fields.label: Font Family

fields.description: Leave Wingdings, Symbol and Webdings text alone. GMP forms often draw checkboxes as Wingdings glyphs, and rewriting those to a text font turns every ☑ into a stray letter. Untick only if you want a literal every-font-replaced pass.
fields.label: Preserve Symbol Fonts

fields.description: Optional. Only needed for the PDF watermark and footer, and only when the font cannot be located on the server automatically. Must be a .ttf — reportlab cannot embed OpenType/CFF (.otf) fonts.
fields.label: Font File (.ttf) for Watermarks
